title: Commercial administration
notOperator: This area is only for operators with commercial permission.
scopeNote: Commercial records only. Verification, ranking weights and safety decisions cannot be changed from here — they have no control on this screen and no route behind it.

products.title: Products and prices
products.insertOnly: A price change creates a new version. Existing versions are never edited, so every past order still reconstructs at the price it was bought at.

diagnostics.title: Ranking diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Shows the eligibility verdict and the score breakdown from the same ranking function members see. There is no override.
diagnostics.memberRelative: Relevance for opportunities is scored per viewer, so there is no single global score to show.
